shortlist.story: An AI tool developed at NYU Langone analyses patients' own narratives about injuries that brought them to the ER and predicts who will later develop PTSD.
shortlist.best_title: AI predicts PTSD risk based on stories about what brought patients to the emergency room
shortlist.publisher: NYU Langone Health / NYU Grossman School of Medicine (EurekAlert)
shortlist.why: Peer-reviewed study with a clear result, AI is the reason (NLP on narrative text), directly about a patient-health outcome outside the AI industry.

shortlist.story: The first randomised controlled trial of AI-guided plaque-based care in suspected coronary artery disease patients met its primary endpoint at AHA 2026.
shortlist.best_title: First Randomized Trial of AI-Enabled Plaque-Based Care Meets Primary Endpoint
shortlist.why: Randomised trial result — the gold standard of evidence; AI is explicitly the differentiating intervention; cardiology outcome in real patients.

shortlist.story: An AI system reading heart MRIs outperformed clinicians at predicting death risk in a study of 27,382 patients, though a survival benefit has not yet been proven in practice.
shortlist.best_title: AI Heart MRI Readings Edged Out Clinicians in Predicting Death Risk Among 27,382 Patients, but Benefit Is Unproven
shortlist.why: Large-scale study with a concrete comparative result; AI is the reason; real patient data. Headline itself flags the caveat, which is honest.

shortlist.story: A study found that AI analysis of ECG data from consumer smartwatches can detect reduced heart-pumping function, though roughly one in eleven patients received conflicting results.
shortlist.best_title: AI-analysis of ECG data measured by smartwatch may help detect reduced heart pumping function
shortlist.why: Published study result via AHA; AI is the reason; has real-world accessibility angle (consumer wearables). Limitation noted in headline.

shortlist.story: AI-interpreted echocardiograms were found comparable to human cardiologist reports while cutting the time cardiologists spend on reporting by about 50%.
shortlist.best_title: AI-interpreted echocardiograms comparable to human reports, cardiologists' time cut by about 50%
shortlist.why: Study result from AHA Scientific Sessions; AI is clearly the reason for the efficiency gain; concrete measurable outcome in clinical practice.

shortlist.story: Researchers used machine learning to map the trade-offs in how smallholder farmers in Malawi allocate crop residues, identifying pathways to improve soil health and food security.
shortlist.best_title: Machine Learning Explores Crop Residue Allocation Trade-Offs in Malawian Farming Systems
shortlist.why: Completed research study with a real-world application in a specific country; AI/ML is the reason for the analysis; climate and food-security stakes outside the AI industry.

shortlist.story: Environmental organisations are actively using AI tools to track wildfires and wildlife populations in real time.
shortlist.best_title: Environmental Groups Are Using AI To Track Fires and Wildlife While Warning About Data Centre Damage
shortlist.why: Real current deployment by non-AI organisations; AI is the reason for improved monitoring; climate-and-nature topic. The data-centre caveat in the headline needs checking but the core good-news use is plausibly documented.

shortlist.story: The FAA's new AI air-traffic tool is already in live operation at Dallas–Fort Worth Airport and is helping reduce delays.
shortlist.best_title: FAA's new AI air traffic tool is now helping reduce DFW Airport delays
shortlist.why: 'Is now helping' signals in-use deployment; AI is the reason; tangible everyday benefit for travellers; independent government agency, not an AI company claim.

shortlist.story: An international team has published a study in the peer-reviewed journal Caries Research showing AI can predict which people are at high risk of developing cavities.
shortlist.best_title: Researchers use AI to predict cavities
shortlist.why: Published in a named peer-reviewed journal; AI is the reason; everyday health outcome that any reader can relate to.

shortlist.story: A teenager built an AI-powered app that helps interpret autistic cues, and it is now being used by hundreds of families.
shortlist.best_title: Interpreting Autistic Cues Is Difficult, a Teen Built an App That's Helping Hundreds of Families
shortlist.why: Real demonstrated use ('helping hundreds of families'); accessibility topic; human story with a named actor; AI is plausibly the mechanism—needs source check to confirm.

shortlist.story: A researcher at the University of Pittsburgh has developed a generative-AI framework that screens existing drug compounds for new therapeutic potential, potentially shortening the drug-discovery pipeline.
shortlist.best_title: He's using AI to screen existing compounds for therapeutic potential
shortlist.why: Completed framework with presented results; AI is the reason; drug-discovery outcome outside the AI industry. Lab-stage caveat applies.

shortlist.story: Pennsylvania has enacted a law specifically targeting AI-generated deceptive advertising, making it a legal offence.
shortlist.best_title: Pennsylvania Enacts Artificial Intelligence Deceptive Advertising Act
shortlist.why: Bad news is the well-documented problem of AI-generated deceptive ads; good side is a law that has actually been enacted (system is responding); no individual was hurt in the predicate story; the new law is a separate verifiable fact.

shortlist.story: After OpenAI breached an Australian government portal, Australia announced it will create a mandatory AI safety regulator.
shortlist.best_title: Australia to launch AI safety regulator after OpenAI's breach of a government portal
shortlist.why: Bad news (government portal breach) was widely covered; good side is a concrete regulatory decision already announced (system is responding); no individual was physically hurt or defrauded in the predicate story; regulatory action is a separate documented fact.

shortlist.story: Instagram is rolling out AI-powered age-verification checks globally to stop teenagers from accessing adult content by entering false birthdays.
shortlist.best_title: Instagram takes AI age checks global to catch teens using adult birthdays
shortlist.why: Bad news (minors circumventing age gates on social media) is a widely covered concern; good side is a specific technical fix now being shipped globally (the fix); no individual was physically hurt in the predicate story; deployment is a verifiable separate fact.
